## Expected behavior

<!-- What should have happened, stated as behavior, not as a preference. -->

## Basis for that expectation

<!-- WHY we expect it: the brief, stated office policy, a prior call, clinical
     safety, or a general norm. A finding without this is an opinion. -->

## Actual behavior

<!-- What happened. -->

## Evidence

- Call: <!-- call id -->
- Timestamp: <!-- mm:ss in the recording -->
- Quote: <!-- verbatim, from the raw transcript -->

## Reproduction conditions

<!-- What was true when it happened. How many times out of how many attempts. -->

## Impact

<!-- Who is harmed and how. Patient safety / privacy / practice operations. -->

## Attribution

<!-- theirs | ours | environment | mixed | unknown — and the reasoning. -->

## Remaining uncertainty

<!-- What would need to be true to be sure. What we could not check. -->
